title: Roblox Inventory Module
description: Create a reusable Roblox ModuleScript for managing a player's inventory.
requirements: Store inventory items by item name.
Get the quantity of an item.
Return a copy of the inventory data.
Do not depend on Roblox services for the core inventory logic.
acceptance_tests: Adding an item increases its quantity.
Removing an item decreases its quantity.
Removing the final quantity removes the item.
Checking an existing item returns true.
Checking a missing item returns false.
Getting quantity returns the correct number.
Clearing the inventory removes all items.
The module can be required and used without errors.
